_note: Pool rules for the readout. Assignment runs in code, not the model. Lower is better for every metric here.

cpl_usd.source: brief.secondary_goal.target when secondary_goal.metric is cpl_usd, else campaign average
cpl_usd.label: Secondary goal

cpm_usd.source: campaign average (total fees / total impressions * 1000) unless the brief sets a reach goal
cpm_usd.label: Reach

order.name: Converters
order.use_next_for: Launches and sales pushes, where CPA decides.

order.name: Lead builders
order.use_next_for: List growth: waitlists, drops, sign-up offers.

order.name: Reach
order.use_next_for: Awareness moments. Don't judge on CPA.

order.name: Test again
order.rule: nothing beat and past_campaigns == 0 (first campaign with the brand)
order.use_next_for: One more campaign with a converting hook, same fee.

order.name: Don't rebook
order.use_next_for: Leave out of the next roster.

custom_pools: A brand can add pools (name, metric, target, position in the order). Same thresholds.
